lines: As my fight with the Harpies became a struggle, before I knew it, Fürst and Hebiko-chan had disappeared.
So that means that Hebiko was abducted by that Fürst...!
We need to send a rescue party right away...!!
Unfortunately, all rapid response units are out on missions. Right now, the only squad that can go to rescue Hebiko-chan is...
Let me go with you too.
Hotaru-senpai stepped forward with a pained look on her face. She must have felt responsible for Hebiko getting kidnapped.
It would be reassuring if you'd come with us, Hotaru-senpai. Enough so that I wanted to ask you to. But before that, I have something I want to say as the captain.
Hebiko is also a Taimanin. She was kidnapped due deficiencies in her own abilities. It's not your fault at all, Hotaru-senpai.
...You're right. Hebiko-chan is a fine Taimanin as well.
We will absolutely save her. But...
I recalled the time we had fought against Fürst here.
Fürst had created a gate in space and disappeared through it. If it was the same as then, how could we followー
Someone who calls themselves the "Snake Charmer" has contacted us. They mentioned you by name, Fuma-kun. They said if you want to save Hebiko, come to the designated location.
That means Hebiko was taken hostage to get me!? I was their target all along!?
I'm not sure. But for now, we have no choice but to go along with it.
The chance of this being a trap was high. But right now we had no other leads.
(Why me... no, now's not the time to think but the time to act.)
I contacted Shikanosuke (on his day off) right away and, together with Hotaru-senpai, began preparing for our departure.
